source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Cálicem * salutáris accípiam et nomen Dómini invocábo.
text.en: I will take the cup of salvation; * and call upon the Name of the Lord.

text.la: Cum his, * qui odérunt pacem eram pacíficus: dum loquébar illis, impugnábant me gratis.
text.en: With them * that hate peace I was peaceable; when I spoke unto them they fought against me without a cause.

text.la: Ab homínibus * iníquis líbera me, Dómine.
text.en: O Lord, preserve me * from the wicked man.

text.la: Custódi me * a láqueo, quem statuérunt mihi, et a scándalis operántium iniquitátem.
text.en: Keep me * from the snare which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

text.la: Considerábam * ad déxteram, et vidébam, et non erat qui cognósceret me.
text.en: I looked * on my right hand and beheld: but there was no man that would know me.

text.la: Cum accepísset acétum, * dixit: Consummátum est: et inclináto cápite, emísit spíritum.
text.en: When He had received the vinegar, * he said: It is finished! and he bowed his Head, and gave up the Ghost.

office.title: Feria Sexta in Passione et Morte Domini
